subject: Post-demo: log retention, backups and data erase workflow — evidence & timeline
messages:
From: Avery Neal <avery.neal@healthia.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <procurement@healthia.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — retention & log questions

Rafael / team,

Thanks again for the demo today — the product looked promising. A couple of follow-up items our security team asked me to document so we can move to procurement: 

- SOC 2: can you confirm Redwood's current attestation (Type II / date / scope) and provide a PDF of the latest report or a SOC 2 summary?
- Log retention: how long are request/usage logs retained by default? Are there tiers for longer retention?
- Backups & snapshots: what is the retention policy for backups and how are backups handled with respect to deletions?
- Delete/erase SLA: if a Healthia user requests deletion (or we request a bulk erase), what is the SLA for primary data and for backups/snapshots? How do you confirm completion?
- Evidence: we'll likely need redacted examples of the deletion workflow, retention diagram, and any relevant audit log entries for proof.

Also: attached is our vendor security questionnaire (we typically populate this and send it back). Please let me know a point of contact on your side to kick that off — we try to get a first pass turn-around in 3 business days if possible.

Appreciate a short timeline (and any attachments you can share) so we can map the procurement route.

Best,
Avery Neal
Sr. Security Program Manager | Healthia
avery.neal@healthia.com
[Attachment referenced: Healthia_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Avery Neal <avery.neal@healthia.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap and next steps for Healthia — data lifecycle evidence

Hi Avery — great to meet you and the security team on the call. Summary + immediate next steps below. I copied Ben and Marissa to handle the questionnaire and SOW details.

Quick summary (what we covered)
- Redwood currently maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering our hosted API and control plane (latest assessment completed 2024; we'll attach the summary PDF). Full reports are shared under NDA.
- Default retention: request/usage logs retained 90 days by default (configurable to longer windows for enterprise accounts).
- Backups / snapshots: snapshot retention depends on the contract — standard hosted customers have 90-day snapshot retention; enterprise customers can configure 180+ day retention and custom restore windows.
- Deletion SLA: for primary customer data we offer deletion within 30 days of a verified request for standard plans; enterprise customers can negotiate a 7–30 day service-level for primary data, with backups subject to snapshot retention windows (typical backup purge within 90–180 days, depending on plan and legal holds). We provide deletion confirmation artifacts (audit log entry + job run ID).

Action items / what we'll send by EOD
1) Redwood_SOC2_summary_2024.pdf (high-level assertion & scope) — Rafael
2) retention-diagram.png showing where logs and backups live and purge windows — Rafael
3) Ben will act as the primary owner for the Healthia questionnaire and return a completed copy — Ben
4) Marissa will scope potential enterprise retention configurations and produce an optional SOW for extended backup retention/shorter erase SLAs — Marissa

Questions for Healthia
- Is there a minimum backup retention Healthia requires (we can map the enterprise configuration)?
- Are there legal holds or regulatory constraints that would preclude immediate backup purge?

Proposed follow-up: 30 minute sync early next week to review the completed questionnaire and evidence. Are you available Wed or Thu morning PT?

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
[Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary_2024.pdf, retention-diagram.png]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Avery Neal <avery.neal@healthia.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap and next steps — questionnaire and technical evidence

Avery — I can take point on the questionnaire. Thanks Rafael for the summary.

A few notes on the technical evidence we'll prepare:
- We'll fill out Healthia_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx and return a redacted copy (attaching as Healthia_Security_Questionnaire_v1-completed.docx).
- For deletion evidence, we'll attach a short runbook describing the purge workflow, an anonymized example of an audit log entry showing a deletion confirmation (job ID + timestamp), and a diagram of backup retention lifecycle.
- On backups: if Healthia requires a minimum retention of 180 days we can propose enterprise snapshot retention of 180 days and provide a price delta for the extended retention.

Two asks for your team to help us move quickly:
1) Please share a technical POC for evidence exchange (we prefer a secure S3 bucket or an internal Drive link for artifacts).
2) Confirm whether you need deletion to remove all backup copies immediately, or whether a post-request snapshot purge window (e.g., 30–90 days) is acceptable when covered by a contractual SLA and notification.

I'll attach the completed questionnaire and a sample audit log in my follow-up. Rafael / Marissa — looping you to confirm SOW conversation cadence.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
[Attachment planned: Healthia_Security_Questionnaire_v1-completed.docx]

From: Avery Neal <avery.neal@healthia.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Legal Ops <procurement@healthia.com>, Sanjay Iyer <sanjay.iy@healthia.com>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap and next steps for Healthia — data lifecycle evidence

Hi Rafael / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Minimum backup retention: Healthia's baseline requirement is 180 days for snapshots/backups.
- Deletion SLA: for user-initiated deletions we need primary data removed and confirmation within 45 days. For backups, we expect purge within 180 days unless a legal hold is applied; legal holds will be raised by our Legal Ops team (cc'd).
- Evidence: please provide the SOC 2 summary, retention diagram, the deletion runbook, and the anonymized audit log example you mentioned.

Sanjay Iyer (cc) will be our technical contact for receiving sample artifacts — Sanjay, can you confirm the preferred secure upload (S3 vs Drive)?

We'll also complete the questionnaire and return by EOD Friday — happy to review a preliminary SOW for a 180-day snapshot retention add-on.

Thanks,
Avery Neal
Sr. Security Program Manager | Healthia
avery.neal@healthia.com
[Attachment: Healthia_Security_Questionnaire_v1-completed.docx (to be returned)]
